text:
alex: quick proposal — enforce per-model-family quotas (monthly tokens + sustained tps) and separate small burst buckets per org/key. idea: default soft-burst (10k tokens) that decays, and hard cap per-family.

maria: +1. console needs per-model-family card and alert rule. if a team hits family cap they should see immediate guidance (reduce batch size / switch to smaller model). :chart_with_downwards_trend:

taylor: enforcement location matters. prefer LB-level token bucket for latency, with service fallback for consistency. LB can return 429 fast.

sam: billing note: if LB throttles before charging, metrics might diverge. we need unified telemetry so billing matches observed consumption.

priya: SDK/backoff behavior: return 429 + headers. sample headers:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30
X-Quota-ModelFamily: rw-xl
X-Quota-Remaining: 0
X-Quota-Burst-Remaining: 0
```
Also emit `quota.event` to kinesis with reason=family-hardcap

june: from product POV, show 'Burst remaining' & 'Projected exhaustion' on route config and allow one-click request for temporary raise. also an audit trail for manual overrides.

quota-bot: NOTE: current experiments show rw-xl family consumes 3x tokens per call vs rw-small. recommend 2-tier default: small/med/large families.

alex: next steps: (1) draft API header spec + error semantics (2) LB prototype with token-bucket plugin (3) console mockups for family-level cards. volunteers?

maria: i'll take console mockups

taylor: i'll pair with infra for LB plugin

sam: i'll own telemetry schema changes and billing alignment

priya: i'll update SDK retry guide

alex: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
